name: split-button
title: Split button
description: A main action with a chevron that opens the alternatives, like Save and Save as draft: one click does the common thing, the menu holds the rest, and it can remember the choice.
docs: The chevron is named "More options for <label>". Loading and disabled apply to the main button only; a loading button is aria-disabled, not disabled, so keyboard focus stays on it. With remember, store the id from onRememberChange and pass it back as rememberedId on the next visit.
